title: calls
description: The who-calls-whom catalog for workload mutual TLS: for each callee, the identities outside its own release that may call it, per environment. It renders as the `peers` of the `tls` fragment (fragments/tls.json). Grants only: a chart grants its own release's account to itself.

services.description: Keyed by '<project>/<component>': the project that owns the chart and the key the chart exposes as 'tls.peers.<component>'.

gateway_fronted.description: An edge terminates TLS and forwards cleartext to this component, so it can never be strict.

environments.description: Keyed by environment name. List an environment even with no peers: an empty list says somebody looked and granted nobody; an absent one says nobody has.

strict.description: Run this component with tls mode strict where the estate enforces it. Inert elsewhere.

name.description: One account or project name, never a pattern.

project.description: A project of the estate; its namespace is its own name, so none is stated.

platform.description: A caller that is not a project (an ingress gateway, say); it states its own namespace.

why.description: Required: a grant with no reason is the shape a stale grant takes.
